notes.title: Version 0.1.3
notes.notes:
With this patch we try to add some juice to the game.


Rework to the Pause Menu with new controls screen.
Added a new hurt effect when Oona is damaged.
Added some juicy camera shakes.
Now you can see the enemies more easily.
Added some effects when you complete a puzzle.
Reworked the texts in the game.
Added some help in the milhouros fights.

notes.title: Version 0.1.2
notes.notes:
This first patch is focused on some bug fixing.


Credits Updated! Take a look.
Now the keys of the tutorials change if you are playing with keyboard.
Now the Pause Menu is open with the "ESC" key in keyboard.
Fixed some strange behaviour on the Carnivorous Plant and added the key that must be pressed to escape.
Added some limitations for the glide skill.
Fixed a lot of little bugs on the level.
Now the Milhouro cannot get bugged with the Spawn skill.
Fixed a strange bug that made the Turret Plants stop working.
